name: 76667 · Mexia, TX
findings: ZIP 76667 (Mexia) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76667 (Mexia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76667 (Mexia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 58% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
